findings.message: 2 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "<button class="tg-btn tg-btn--" (14px from the right); "<div class="tg-grid"><div clas" (14px from the right)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: 43 panel borders are dark against their ground: #ffffff on #212d3b (13.97:1) | #ffffff on #212d3b (13.97:1) | #ffffff on #212d3b (13.97:1)
findings.fix: A panel border is a whisper: about 1.1–1.3:1 against its ground on a light screen (#e5e7eb–#ededed on white), and about 1.2–1.5:1 on a dark one (#1a1a1a on #000, #2e2e2e on #111). Darker lines turn the screen into a grid of boxes; keep the stronger line for controls.

findings.message: Only 2 of 35 blocks start on the first 1440px screen.
findings.fix: Every block the brief names shows its header and first rows on the first desktop screen: size the headline block to its question, cap long lists with "View all", and put time-sensitive blocks before long tables.
